question_patterns: 為什麼聽到好聽的歌，手臂會起雞皮疙瘩
first_sentence: 這是雞皮疙瘩！因為覺得冷，毛就豎起來。
facts: 皮膚下有很小的肌肉，會拉動毛根
很多動物靠毛豎起來保暖或嚇人
害怕或感動的時候，也會起雞皮疙瘩
ask_back: 起雞皮疙瘩的時候，皮膚摸起來像什麼？

bridges.has_cat: 你家的貓咪生氣的時候，毛會豎起來嗎？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: what are these bumps on my skin
why does my skin get bumpy
why do my arms get bumps
en.first_sentence: This is goosebumps! Tiny hairs stand up when you feel cold.
facts: Tiny muscles under your skin pull on each hair.
Many animals fluff up their fur to stay warm.
You can also get goosebumps when you feel scared or moved.
en.ask_back: Do you think goosebumps are for keeping warm, or for scaring things?

bridges.has_cat: When your cat gets angry, does its fur stand up?
